prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: hit while turning left in Conroe, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported shoulder injury. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1469; do not mention it.)
text: Officer narrative. On arrival at the intersection in Conroe, Texas, I observed a two-vehicle collision involving a sedan and an SUV. Driver 1 was operating the sedan and stated that he was traveling straight through the intersection when the SUV, operated by Driver 2, turned left across his path. Driver 2 stated that he was turning left at a green light and did not see the sedan approaching until impact. Both vehicles sustained front-end and driver-side damage and were towed from the scene. A passenger in the SUV was present but was not injured. Driver 1 reported pain in his right shoulder and declined transport by ambulance at the scene. Traffic signal timing and witness statements were reviewed. Driver 2 was issued a citation for failure to yield the right-of-way while turning left. Both drivers provided insurance information and exchanged contact details before leaving the scene.
